provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench development fixture; no external theme copied.
runtime_subset: Static Shopify section-schema JSON constraints and Theme Check only; no theme editor or storefront rendering.
prompt: Repair only the JSON schema in sections/feature-panel.liquid. Keep every byte outside the schema block unchanged. Include exactly one top-level schema block with strict JSON (no comments, duplicate JSON keys, or non-finite numbers). Its root fields must be exactly name, settings, presets; name must remain Feature panel. Declare exactly three unique settings, in any order, each with a nonempty label: heading (text, default Highlights), show_summary (checkbox, boolean default true), and columns (range, min 1, max 4, step 1, numeric default 3). Each setting may contain only the listed fields plus id/type/label. Include exactly one preset named Feature panel, with exactly these settings: heading = Featured picks, show_summary = false, columns = 2. No other preset fields, unknown setting IDs, or changes to markup. Do not disable checks. This task validates schema structure and declared values offline, not theme-editor behavior.
